procedure: git clone --no-local of the committed repository to an empty temporary directory
Build a wheel from that clone without resolving new dependencies
Replace the editable installation with the built wheel in the previously clean environment
Run all 24 core tests from the clone
Import model1 data with the cloned prepare_data.py
Run python -I -m hac_forward.reconstruct for model1 from the clone using the installed wheel
note: No reconstruction algorithm change followed this commit; later commit records this receipt and handoff status.
